footballer.glb is built by scripts/build_footballer.py from:

- Universal Base Characters [Standard] by Quaternius (male body, eyes, hair meshes and their
  textures), https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-base-characters
- Universal Animation Library [Standard] by Quaternius (skeleton and clips, via
  web/vendor/quaternius/mannequin.glb), https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library

Both are released under CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication),
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ , as stated in License_Standard.txt of each
pack (downloaded 18 Oct 2026).

Our changes (rebinding, kit regions, UVs, decimation) are released under the repository's MIT licence.

anime.glb is built by scripts/build_anime.py from:

- HairSample_Male.vrm and Base_Male.vrm, sample models of VRoid Studio by the VRoid Project
  (pixiv), https://opengameart.org/content/vroid-studio-cc0-models

The VRoid help centre states that the VRoid Studio sample models are released under CC0,
https://vroid.pixiv.help/hc/en-us/articles/4402614652569 (read 18 Oct 2026), and the
OpenGameArt page lists them as CC0 1.0 Universal,
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ . The skeleton and clips are the mannequin's
(see above).

Our changes (rebinding to the mannequin skeleton, kit regions, hair restyling, face atlas,
decimation) are released under the repository's MIT licence.
